contentPattern.structure: default: one row | step counter + step title ("Schritt 1 von 3", "Termin auswählen") | next step text |; the bar fill comes from "N von M"
contentPattern.stepper: option stepper: one row per step | Step title | optional "current" |, or one cell with a list (bold = current step)

usage: Header above multi-step forms (consultation booking, contract cancellation, customer-area forms). Used on 42 catalogued pages (reuse count 42), e.g. https://www.ergo.de/de/Geschaeftskunden-Produkte/kontakt-geschaeftskunden, https://www.ergo.de/de/Produkte/Krankenversicherung/Augenversicherung, https://www.ergo.de/de/Produkte/Krankenversicherung/gesundheitsvorsorge.
reuseGuidance: Pair with the form block on multi-step form pages; use the stepper option for the numbered step indicator. Step navigation, live form state and submission are out of scope for now: the block renders the authored steps statically.
